gold.observation: Total Blocking Time is 780 ms — the lab proxy for INP, not a measured field INP — which is high; LCP (2,400 ms) and CLS (0.05) are good. The heaviest scripts are /static/vendor.bundle.js (980,000 bytes, 1,340 ms) and /static/app.bundle.js (420,000 bytes, 760 ms).
gold.potential_cause: The large JavaScript bundles — /static/vendor.bundle.js (980,000 bytes) and /static/app.bundle.js (420,000 bytes) — are the likely source of the main-thread work driving the high TBT.
gold.suggested_optimization: Reduce and split the JavaScript: code-split or defer /static/vendor.bundle.js (980,000 bytes) and /static/app.bundle.js so less script parses and executes on the main thread during load.
